subject: Hosted API: monthly commit boost + soft-throttle onboarding
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina@brightorder.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@brightorder.com
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal — request to increase monthly commit and confirm soft-throttle behavior

Hi Karthik,

We're starting our budgeting for H1 and want to convert our current retainer into a formal hosted API monthly commit. Usage has grown faster than expected — current monthly average sits at ~1.2M tokens/day. Finance and engineering are aligned on a conservative commit plan: move to a 40M token/month commitment (up from current 12M).

Two asks from procurement:
- Confirm effective unit rate for a 40M/month commit (term: 12 months).
- Ensure a soft-throttle policy for burst days (we need graceful degradation and predictable 503/429 signals rather than silent failures).

We can circulate a PO & POC this week if we have numbers. Can you run numbers and share a short summary for our legal/procurement?

Thanks,
Lina
Procurement Manager | BrightOrder Inc.
Attachments: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina@brightorder.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal — request to increase monthly commit and confirm soft-throttle behavior

Thanks Lina — appreciate the head's up. High level proposal below (short and actionable):

Option A — Committed path (recommended)
- Commit: 40M tokens / month
- Term: 12 months
- Effective unit rate: $0.0009 per token (volume-discounted; replaces pay-as-you-go pricing)
- Burst behavior: soft-throttle bucket (automatic burst credits up to 25% of monthly commit; after that requests are queued for up to 3s and then return a clear 429 with reason code)

Option B — Hybrid (commit + larger burst pocket)
- Commit: 30M tokens / month + 12M burst pocket per month (pre-purchased)
- Effective unit rate on committed volume: $0.0010 per token
- Burst pocket priced at $0.0007 per token used from pocket

I attached a 1-page pricing_summary_20271207.pdf and a brief provisioning checklist for onboarding. If you want I can convert Option A into a DocuSign-ready amendment and include the PO fields for your procurement team.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm preferred option and billing contact.
2) We send an amendment (DocuSign) + updated SLA excerpt that clarifies soft-throttle behavior and retry guidance.
3) Onboarding call to review caching/batching recommendations and set up traffic shaping (30–45 minutes).

If you'd like a quick call today, I have a 2pm PT slot.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — Renewals, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0191
Attachments: pricing_summary_20271207.pdf, redwood_provisioning_checklist.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lina Torres <lina@brightorder.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal — request to increase monthly commit and confirm soft-throttle behavior

Looping in from GTM / approval side — happy to support Option A at the rate Karthik quoted. Two internal notes:
- We can extend a one-time onboarding credit equal to one week of committed usage to ease traffic spikes during cutover.
- Approve SLA language tweak to document explicit 429 behavior and the timescale for queued requests.

Kimberly — can you confirm procurement ops can accept PO + DocuSign (we'll need a billing contact and P.O. number to finalize)?

Marissa
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
From: Lina Torres <lina@brightorder.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@brightorder.com
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal — request to increase monthly commit and confirm soft-throttle behavior

Thanks Karthik and Marissa — Option A looks good. Procurement has asked for the following to be included in the amendment:
- Billing contact: Hannah Lowe (hannah.lowe@brightorder.com)
- PO number (we'll send PO once DocuSign shows total amount)
- SOC 2 Type II evidence link for compliance review (we need this before countersign)

I've attached our preliminary PO (BrightOrder_PO_20271215.pdf) for reference. Can you add the onboarding credit line you mentioned? Also confirm the DocuSign link so our legal can route.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Lina
